accuracy.input_policy: Per-record inherited original delta rounded upward to a decimal envelope. Four records use1e-27, others1e-26. Inexact source mantissas do not add evidence.
accuracy.component_metric: estimated absolute error <=10^-digits * max(1,abs(coefficient)); this is not21 significant digits for small nonzero coefficients
accuracy.input_limitation: Original delta is an inherited/summed dropped-tail estimate from the highest epsilon order, with requested24-digit acceptance. It is not independent25+ digit validation. Uniform20-significant-digit FF acceptance needs roughly10fold tighter projected uncertainty; source regeneration or stronger independent boundary evidence remains needed.
accuracy.independence: Native and original use the same supplied starting values. Their difference tests independent transport/projection, not the unknown true starting-value error.

normalization: Exact MH²=1 units, MV²=1/b for each context; multiply -b²/(4*pi)^4 exactly once. UFO overall couplings/color/Lorentz tensors are not included.
